k.q: Count the 1 bits in a five-bit binary value using iteration and selection.
k.code:
array bits = [1,0,1,1,0]
ones = 0
for i = 0 to 4
    if bits[i] == 1 then
        ones = ones + 1
    endif
next i
print(ones)
p: Change bits[1] from 0 to 1; count again.
Convert the original unsigned binary 10110 into denary using its place values.
k.a: The original five-bit number 10110 has three 1 bits, so output is 3. Changing index 1 to 1 gives four 1 bits (11110). The original binary value is 16+4+2 = 22 denary; counting set bits and converting place values are different operations.
